page.overview:
Who is Walker Keel?

Walker Keel was a Human male Starfleet officer in the 24th century. He had two sisters, Anne and Melissa.

Early in his career, Keel was close friends with fellow officers Jean-Luc Picard and Jack R. Crusher, the former of whom he met in an exotic bar on Tau Ceti III. Keel would later introduce Crusher to his future wife Beverly Howard.

By 2364, Keel had been promoted to captain and assigned as the commanding officer of the . Also by this time, after having witnessed the strange behavior of key Starfleet Command personnel, and even of Horatios first officer and chief medical officer, he was one of a small group of officers who had become suspicious about the state of Starfleet.

That same year, Keel used code 47 to summon Captain Picard, of the , to a clandestine meeting on Dytallix B. Also attending were Captain of the , and Captain Tryla Scott of the . Keel, Rixx, and Scott attempted to trick Picard into misremembering old associations (a failing exhibited by officers the trio had deemed suspicious). Having confirmed Picard's trustworthiness, Keel revealed his fears to his old friend.
